title: The Cloned-Voice Grandparent Scam
caller: claims to be her grandson Jake

lines.speaker: Caller
lines.text: Grandma? It's me, Jake... I'm in real trouble.

lines.speaker: Margaret
lines.text: Jake? Oh my goodness, what's wrong, you sound strange.

lines.speaker: Caller
lines.text: I got in a car accident and I got arrested. I'm in jail right now. Please, you have to help me.

lines.speaker: Margaret
lines.text: Arrested? Should I call your mother?

lines.speaker: Caller
lines.text: No! Please don't tell mom, she'll be so disappointed. Keep this between us, okay? Promise me.

lines.speaker: Caller
lines.text: My lawyer says I need $4,000 for bail right now or I have to stay here overnight. There isn't much time.

lines.speaker: Margaret
lines.text: Four thousand dollars? How would I even send that?

lines.speaker: Caller
lines.text: The bail bondsman only takes a wire transfer. Don't hang up, stay on the line and I'll walk you through it. We have to do this in the next few minutes.
